usage.notes: Panacea retrieves citation metadata through its server-side E-utilities adapter; the browser does not call NCBI directly.

license.scope: Bibliographic metadata/API use. Full-text article rights are separate and must not be inferred from PubMed indexing.
license.notes: Verify current NCBI database/API policies before expanding redistribution or caching beyond citation metadata.

validation.notes: PubMed indexing establishes bibliographic provenance, not study quality, guideline status, causality, or individual clinical applicability.

provenance.authority: U.S. National Library of Medicine / National Center for Biotechnology Information
provenance.notes: Preserve PMID, source, query and retrieval timestamp for every displayed record.

adapter.notes: Existing production adapter performs PubMed esearch then esummary and returns normalized citation metadata.

trust.notes: Trust score applies to the bibliographic source and reproducibility of retrieval, not to the quality of every indexed study.
